newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's c.bank injects 1.25 bln dirhams.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's c.bank injects 1.25 bln dirhams.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 1.255 billion dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.

The bank received bids totalling 4.297 billion dirhams and allocated 3.305 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 4.560 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 76.91 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on April 23, 1997.
